verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's docs explicitly cover A/B Tests and Experiments, metric type selection, and Bayesian statistics for deciding a winning variation, directly matching the PM story of running experiments on flags and seeing which variation wins on metrics. Community evidence corroborates multivariate flags and rollout targeting as real, used features. Missing for 10: independent hands-on account of running a full experiment and reading results dashboards, and more detail on multivariate (not just binary) experiment support.
